coreAttributes.name: 'GOODBYE'
coreAttributes.description: A pepperball pistol, heavily modified by [#(flags.hasFlag('xys_ringmaker_quest_complete'))?'Ysette':'a certain ringmaker'] to shoot concentrated arcane bullets instead of pepperballs. Stamped on the body is an insignia of a heart surrounded by a chain, along with the word [style.colourDmgLust("GOODBYE")] in cursive.
coreAttributes.equipText: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(unholster)] the pistol and focus [npc.her] arcane energy into its unique magazine, arcane bullets forming inside, before slapping it in, then [npc.verb(turn)] the safety off.
coreAttributes.unequipText: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(take)] out the magazine and [npc.verb(turn)] the safety on, before [npc.she] [npc.verb(holster)] the pistol.

hitDescriptions.hitText: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(line)] [npc2.name] up in [npc.her] sights and [npc.verb(pull)] the trigger. The round hits [npc2.her] [npc2.arm] and dissipates on impact, making [npc2.herHim] [npc2.moan] from the sudden increased arousal.

missDescriptions.missText: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(line)] [npc2.name] up in [npc.her] sights and [npc.verb(pull)] the trigger. The hazy bullet misses [npc2.herHim] completely and dissipates uselessly in the distance.
